data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $60,654,000 there is a deterioration of $5,306,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2020: release $1,052,000).

prior_year_events.event_name: Back year deterioration on GAAP basis
prior_year_events.impact_description: Contributed to back year deterioration on a GAAP basis and the profit declared on the 2019 year of account, influenced by margin added over and above actuarial best estimates and additional information from pricing current and prospective business.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net deterioration of $5.306 million in claims reserves established at the prior year end. This back year deterioration on a GAAP basis was influenced by the syndicate's reserving methodology, which incorporated additional margin over actuarial best estimates and information from pricing current and prospective business. The deterioration contributed to the profit declared on the 2019 year of account.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration of $5,306,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end
margin added over and above actuarial best estimates, has contributed to the back year deterioration on a GAAP basis
assumptions underlying our reserving methodology reflect additional information obtained from pricing current and prospective business
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is net of reinsurance as no gross figure was explicitly stated or derivable from the claims development triangle in a way that matched the narrative. Gross premium mix is based on the statement that 'All business written by the syndicate is reinsurance' as the segmental analysis provided is by geographical source, not line of business.
